item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 20/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Rai will take a northerly track today, moving across the central part of the South China Sea and weakening gradually. Rain bands associated with Rai will bring rainy weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly in the latter part of this week. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, the weather is expected to become cool again over the coast of southern China during Christmas holidays.

Date/Month: 20/12 (Monday)

Weather: Cloudy with occasional rain. Rain will be more frequent later. It will be cool.
Temp range: 15 - 19 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
